name: Exp_BrakeExp
summary: This EA trades based on the custom BrakeExp indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals while closing opposing positions. It uses a trend-following approach with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, operating on a user-specified timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义BrakeExp指标进行交易，在上涨信号时开多仓并在下跌信号时开空仓，同时平掉反向持仓。它采用趋势跟踪策略，具有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈水平，运行在用户指定的时间周期上。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用BrakeExp指标识别趋势方向和交易信号。入场条件为：当BrakeExp指标的UpSignal缓冲区有值时开多仓，DnSignal缓冲区有值时开空仓。出场条件包括：当反向趋势信号出现时平仓（UpTrend存在时平空仓，DnTrend存在时平多仓），以及止损和止盈触发。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。EA采用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，仅在新K线形成时评估交易条件。策略支持独立控制买入和卖出的开仓与平仓权限，提供了灵活的交易方向控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy uses the BrakeExp custom indicator to identify trend direction and trade signals. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the UpSignal buffer has a non-zero value, and open a sell position when the DnSignal buffer has a non-zero value. Exit conditions include closing opposing positions when trend buffers are active (close sells when UpTrend is present, close buys when DnTrend is present), plus stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, evaluating trade conditions only when a new bar forms. The strategy supports independent permission controls for opening and closing both buy and sell positions, providing flexible directional trading control.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot; negative = lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数齐全，风险可控
买卖方向权限独立控制，策略灵活性高
支持固定手数和存款比例两种仓位管理模式
使用信号K线索引参数，可避免信号延迟或过度拟合
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar
Stop loss and take profit parameters are complete, making risk controllable
Independent buy/sell permission controls provide high strategy flexibility
Supports both fixed lot size and deposit share position sizing modes
Signal bar index parameter allows avoiding signal lag or overfitting
cons: 依赖自定义BrakeExp指标，指标源码不可见，策略逻辑不透明
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致仓位叠加
止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，不适合所有品种
缺少最大持仓数量限制和总风险控制机制
cons_en: Depends on a custom BrakeExp indicator whose source is unavailable, making strategy logic opaque
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No position check before opening, which may cause repeated entries and position stacking
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large for all instruments
Lacks maximum position count limits and overall risk control mechanisms
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过度叠加
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提高风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent repeated same-direction entries causing excessive position stacking
Add spread filter and maximum position count limits to improve risk management

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查，可能同方向重复开仓
止损止盈点数较大，在波动性低的品种上可能长期无法触发止盈
risk_points_en: No position count check, potentially allowing repeated same-direction entries
Large stop loss and take profit values may result in prolonged open positions on low-volatility instruments

It uses a trend-following approach with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, operating on a user-specified timeframe.
